crop.notes: Right side of the column is cut off throughout, including the headline; the crop is a long multi-item sporting column (Muldoon, billiards, gymnasium). The Allen part is one line in 'The Sprinting Tourney', which is readable.

ocr.notes: Transcript follows the cropped column, so every line is truncated at the right.

title.suggested: Tom Allen to Referee Sprint Handicap at Sportsman's Park

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that heats were drawn at Tom Kelly's for a 135-yard handicap sprint at Sportsman's Park the next Sunday, with Tom Allen to act as referee.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Friday Morning, January 26, 1883, page 6. Missouri Republican until 1888.

facts.fact: Allen was named referee of a 135-yard handicap sprint at Sportsman's Park, St. Louis

notes: A wider crop of just 'The Sprinting Tourney' item would be better. Race date is 'next Sunday' after Friday Jan 26, 1883.
